    # Dispense 500 uL into all 96 wells of destination_plate.
    #
    # Constraint handling:
    #   - Tips are 50 uL max (TIP_50ul_L), so the 500 uL target is
    #     delivered as 10 partial aspirate/dispense cycles of 50 uL.
    #   - This assumes an 8-channel pipetting head. The deck JSON
    #     declares no pipette, so verify lh channel count against the
    #     actual backend before running on hardware.

    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    num_channels = 8            # must match installed pipetting head
    target_vol_ul = 500         # final volume per destination well
    max_tip_vol_ul = 50         # physical capacity of TIP_50ul_L tips

    full_cycles = target_vol_ul // max_tip_vol_ul    # 10
    remainder = target_vol_ul % max_tip_vol_ul       # 0

    # Process one destination column (A..H of that column) at a time.
    for col in range(1, 13):
        col_id = "A{}".format(col)   # 8-channel head fans out to A{col}:H{col}

        # Fresh tip column for each destination column.
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[col_id])

        for _ in range(full_cycles):
            # Aspirate 50 uL into each of the 8 tips from trough channel 1
            await lh.aspirate(
                trough["A1"],
                vols=[max_tip_vol_ul] * num_channels,
            )
            # Dispense 50 uL into each of the 8 wells of this column
            await lh.dispense(
                dest[col_id],
                vols=[max_tip_vol_ul] * num_channels,
            )

        if remainder > 0:
            await lh.aspirate(trough["A1"], vols=[remainder] * num_channels)
            await lh.dispense(dest[col_id], vols=[remainder] * num_channels)

        # Return tips before moving to the next destination column
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[col_id])

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")
